en: “The number of damage reports is unprecedented,” says the vehicle expert at the hail drive-in. The consequences of the storm are likely to cost hundreds of millions of francs. After the destructive hailstorm over the canton of Zurich, insurance companies are working on the attack. The damage center shows that for some of those affected, more than just a car was broken.
la: "Numerus damnorum nuntiationum inusitatus est", dicit vehiculum peritum grandinis in autocineto. Tempestatem consecutiones centena milia francorum constare verisimile est. Post grandinem perniciosissimum pagum Tiguri, societates assecurationes in oppugnatione laborant. Centrum damnum ostendit aliquot ex iis qui affecti sunt, plus quam iustus autocinetum fractum esse.
